data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 44.1m at 1 January 2018. During 2018 the syndicate recorded an overall prior-year surplus of GBP 6.2m (a release), primarily reflecting favourable claims development on prior years; despite this release the gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 57.6m at 31 December 2018 driven by current year activity and foreign exchange movements.
raw_causal_phrases: In 2018, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 6.2 million on prior year reserves.
Effect of movements in exchange rates 6.4

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount sourced from narrative sentence referencing a 'surplus of GBP 6.2m' (document does not explicitly label this as gross or net of reinsurance in the sentence). There is a minor inconsistent alternate figure elsewhere (GBP 6.1m) and significant FX movements (+GBP 6.4m) in the gross provisions reconciliation which affect closing balances. A gross claims development triangle is available for 2016-2018 and was used for cross-checking; RITC activity is not indicated to distort the triangle. Prior-year development confidence downgraded to 0.8 due to ambiguity over gross/net explicitness.
